insights: OQ-02 asks for Knaster-Tarski proof of Schroeder-Bernstein, making fixed point explicit
Key operator: T(S) = (range g)^c ∪ g(f(S)) is monotone on Set α
OrderHom.lfp from Mathlib provides the Knaster-Tarski fixed point directly
Fixed point S* partitions α: use f on S*, use g⁻¹ on S*ᶜ
S*ᶜ ⊆ range g follows from (range g)^c ⊆ S* (base inclusion)
g(f(S*)) ⊆ S* (closure) is the key property for injectivity cross-cases
Surjectivity uses contrapositive: b ∉ f(S*) implies g(b) ∉ S*
